description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520000
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels in Homagama. It contains detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and legal determinations under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it focuses on land registrations, property ownership, and title settlements without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
